session.title: Kiara Stumpjumper clipless and suspension validation
session.purpose: Use Saturday Kiara only as a low-risk clipless and Stumpjumper suspension validation ride after Friday produced two MTB files totaling about 293 Garmin load. Protect adaptation from Friday's above-FTP work rather than adding another engine session.

dose.readiness_gate: Proceed only after Saturday-morning Garmin sync if wake Body Battery rebounds well, HRV remains balanced, resting HR is not elevated, legs feel normal, and there is no mental fog from Friday's load.
dose.fallback_if_yellow_or_heavy: Skip Kiara or do 15-25 min condo/parking clipless handling only: start-stop, figure-8, slow roll, and sudden-stop unclip practice. No trail load.
dose.venue: Bukit Kiara / 2K access and low-consequence loops.
dose.loop_cap: Access plus 1 relaxed 2K climb-plus-descent loop. Second loop only if the first loop is clearly easy, clipless release is automatic, and HR stays controlled.
dose.climb_target: 125-155 W average on climbs; absolute cap 170 W. No above-FTP work and no 180-200 W chasing.
dose.hr_cap: Mostly Z1-Z2, brief Z3 acceptable on pitches. No sustained Z4.
dose.descent_rule: Cruise at 5/10, quiet feet, early unclip planning, clean braking, and no segment chasing.
dose.clipless_drills: Before trail consequence, do 6-10 deliberate stop/unclip reps including two surprise-stop simulations at walking speed.
dose.suspension_rule: Do not change more settings tomorrow. Validate the current fork rebound +1 click damping and shock rebound -1 click damping change on the same trail feel before further adjustment.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Friday delivered the overload needed to push FTP/VO2 rebuild. A short, low-load Kiara validation ride on Saturday should improve clipless automaticity and confirm whether the new rebound settings support the more forward position, while still allowing the anaerobic/threshold stimulus to consolidate before Sunday Sabbath.
execution_rules: Treat the first 15 minutes as a readiness test; if legs feel heavy or attention is dull, exit early.
Keep every climb well below threshold. This is not a second engine session.
Use clipless confidence as the technical metric: early release, calm stops, no hesitation during sudden stops.
Use suspension feel as a validation metric only: front support, rear tracking, steep-chute posture, and corner entry/exit calmness.
If you feel tempted to test power, end the session instead of adding work.
Do not make another fork or shock adjustment during the ride unless there is a clear safety/control issue.
Fuel normally if riding longer than 45 minutes, but do not use fueling as permission to extend.

expected_result.next_day: Sunday Sabbath full rest with better chance of absorbing Friday's high-load stimulus.

stop_rules: No ride if Saturday morning Body Battery/HRV/resting HR show a poor response to Friday.
Stop if clipless release is delayed, awkward, or mentally distracting.
Stop if sudden-stop unclipping is not reliable during the pre-trail drills.
Stop if HR drifts into sustained Z4 or climbs require more than 170 W to feel smooth.
Stop after one 2K loop unless the session is clearly easy; absolute cap is 85 Garmin load.
Stop for crash, near-fall, sharp pain, repeated misses, or braking/vision deterioration.
